summary: This May 7, 2026 classroom source extends Game Theory, Strategy, Eschatology, Prediction, Chokepoint, and Power by showing how Jiang turns state worldview into strategy: the real board is not only battlefield escalation but the political system, sacred grammar, finance channel, and civilizational story each player is trying to make the world obey.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: A five- to ten-year game among the United States, Russia, Iran, and Israel is framed through the players' psychology, worldview, constraints, and actual reward rather than through ordinary leader-change headlines.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source directly uses Game Theory as player/worldview identification. It should strengthen the existing method anchor rather than create a standalone WWIII Chessboard page.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The U.S., Russia, Iran, and Israel are treated as actors with distinct civilizational memories, strategic motives, and reasoning systems.
existing_lens_links.rationale: This is a classroom version of empathic state modeling: strategy becomes legible only after the analyst models what each actor's worldview can see and count as victory.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: War is not only defeating a battlefield team; it is putting the opponent in political check by attacking the political system, decision chain, narrative, economy, and social cohesion.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The chessboard passage should feed the existing Strategy board-ordering anchor because the active mechanism is operational feedback across political, economic, narrative, and military dimensions.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Russian Third Rome, Iranian Shia eschatology, Israeli covenant/Greater Israel language, and Kabbalistic transgression are read as strategic grammars rather than private belief.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Eschatology owns sacred role-script and strategic map translation; Game Theory owns the player/worldview method around it.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The closing five- to ten-year four-player forecast should remain an active-watch family, not a broad World War III ledger item.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Prediction owns the source date, horizon, named players, testable subclaims, and later comparison; current pressure is routing and watch discipline, not confirmation.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this source on a future Game Theory compression pass as the state-level chessboard example: the analyst must identify not only players, but each player's worldview, civilizational grammar, and reward structure before judging rationality.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Game Theory owns player/worldview/payoff diagnosis. Strategy owns whether the war form is materially executable; Eschatology owns sacred role-script; Prediction owns dated forecast scoring.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the political-check passage for a future Strategy replacement: war attacks the political system and decision chain, so military pressure is judged by whether it can make an opponent's state architecture fail.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Strategy owns the material and political-system audit; Game Theory owns the chessboard method; Chokepoint owns access/trade chokepoints when geography and supply become the active constraint.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the naval trade-access passage only if the Chokepoint page is being compressed or compared: tanker seizures, maritime pressure, and naval arming are framed as durable trade-access conflict rather than a discrete naval campaign.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Chokepoint owns trade-access and maritime coercion; Strategy owns the larger board; Prediction owns the dated claim that naval trade access will become a major future front.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the Russia/Iran/Israel theological grammar only as replacement evidence if Eschatology needs another compression pass: sacred narratives explain why policy choices persist under loss and why state action can look irrational from outside.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Eschatology should not absorb the whole four-player forecast. It owns sacred role-script and transgression/redemption mechanics; Game Theory and Prediction carry method and scoring.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Record the five- to ten-year U.S./Russia/Iran/Israel forecast as an active-watch family with subclaims for player list, naval trade-access front, political-system attack, Russia succession vulnerability, Iran resilience, Israel/Greater Israel pressure, and four-worldview persistence.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Do not promote this as one World War III ledger item. Prediction owns the source date, horizon, object, and later comparison; neighboring pages own the mechanisms.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the transnational-capital and U.S. debt-management passages only as supporting evidence when Power is already being revised: finance is presented as a force that makes others dependent on weapons, resources, and dollar-order pressure.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power owns finance as abstraction and dependency; Secret Society owns hidden coordination only with stronger secrecy evidence; Strategy owns war executability.

new_lens_seeds.title: Worldview As Strategy
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A state or elite group acts strategically from inside the moral and sacred world it inhabits; the analyst must read its literature, theology, myth, pride, humility, and imagined destiny as part of the strategic board.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This could route future Great Books, Russia, Iran, Israel, U.S. technate, and civilizational-strategy sources, but the current public map can carry it through Game Theory, Eschatology, Stories, Poetry, Strategy, and Prediction without a new page.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a routing seed only. A public page would blur existing parents unless future source clusters show that worldview-as-strategy needs its own durable hover and cannot be carried by Game Theory plus Eschatology.

new_lens_seeds.title: Political-System Check
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: War is treated as a chess attack on the opponent's political system: pieces, pressure points, finance, media, weapons, and ideology matter because they can put the king-state in check.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism could organize future political-system war passages, but Strategy already has the four-dimensional war and hybrid-war anchors that can absorb it.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a seed. Strategy owns the material/political audit; Game Theory owns the board metaphor and player identification.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2026-05-07, this source sits between the April Pax Judaica / Iran-war cluster and the May 12 AI Apocalypse lecture. It is the newest remaining missing corpus-impact source on current main after the AI Apocalypse impact and links were already merged.

The five- to ten-year forecast should be compared as a family, not as one ledger item: player list, political-system war, naval trade-access front, Iran resilience, Israel/Greater Israel pressure, Russia succession vulnerability, and four-worldview persistence have different test paths.

The Kabbalah, Greater Israel, false-flag, and catacomb-tradition passages are high-friction attributed Jiang classroom interpretation; preserve caveats and do not promote them as independent doctrinal or intelligence facts.

canon_candidates.candidate: The May 7, 2026 five- to ten-year U.S./Russia/Iran/Israel worldview-conflict forecast, split into testable subclaims rather than promoted as a broad World War III prediction.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Only compare or promote after later evidence can be assigned to the specific subclaim being scored: naval trade access, political-system attack, Iran resilience, Israel regional escalation, Russia succession vulnerability, or four-player persistence.

next_actions.action: Do not create standalone WWIII Chessboard, Viewpoint Becomes Strategy, Four Players, Greater Israel Project, Kabbalah Strategy, Third Rome Strategy, Shia Exceptionalism, Technate, or Transnational Capital pages from this source alone.

If public synthesis follows, prefer a concept-scoped Game Theory or Strategy replacement/compression pass over an ordinary append; the useful mechanism is worldview/player modeling and political-system check.

If provenance linking follows, only link episode marks whose text names the active mechanism: long-horizon four-player game, transnational-capital counterforces, political-system check, trade-access war, worldview-as-strategy, sacred role-script, or active-watch forecast family.
